sup-064316255265a882-0HL1q18:whole.hint: Identify the geometry producing the field before choosing its formula or hand rule.
notes: For a long straight wire, B = μ₀I/(2πr); for a long ideal solenoid, B = μ₀nI. Here n is turns per unit length.
Use a right-hand grip rule with conventional current. Add fields as vectors, including cancellation between competing contributions.

sup-064316255265a882-0HL1q30:whole.hint: Ask whether the required quantity is energy, energy per coulomb, or force per coulomb.
notes: Electric potential is energy per unit charge: V = E_p/q. For a point charge V = kQ/r, and contributions add as signed scalars.
